bootstrap.unit: publication (Poisson weights), OA and non-OA resampled jointly

w3.label: 3-year window
w3.desc: Citations from works published up to 2 years after the publication year (publication year + 2); cohorts whose window ends after 2025 are excluded.

tier_standardized.method: Direct standardization: within each venue tier, mean NCS(OA) and mean NCS(non-OA); both weighted by the tier's share of all normalized works; ratio of the weighted means. Tiers with no OA or no non-OA works are dropped.

cum.label: Cumulative (to snapshot)
cum.desc: All citations recorded up to the snapshot date; older works have had longer to accumulate citations (matched by publication year in the baseline, but recent cohorts are incomplete).

tier_standardized.method: Direct standardization: within each venue tier, mean NCS(OA) and mean NCS(non-OA); both weighted by the tier's share of all normalized works; ratio of the weighted means. Tiers with no OA or no non-OA works are dropped.

tests.name: No duplicate work identifiers in the analysis table
OA classification consistent between pass 1 and pass 3 (≤ 0.01% mismatch)
Publication years consistent between pass 1 and pass 3 (≤ 0.1% mismatch)
Window citations never exceed cumulative citations
Every subfield reference cell holds ≥ MIN_N works
Mean NCS equals 1 inside every reference cell (expected-value identity)
Sparse / zero-baseline / unclassified works receive no NCS
Work counts reconcile with the dashboard
Citation totals reconcile with the dashboard (≤ 0.5%)
Regional totals count each work once (not a sum of full-counted countries)
